title: Prove exact all-size block fitting rank 49d for paired planes
body:
PR2484 determines scalar fitting rank 49 for PR1825’s fixed paired-plane mask. This contribution proves that arbitrary vector-valued linear coding cannot lower its normalized rank: for every field and every positive block size d, the minimum is exactly 49d, even with nonsymmetric, noncommuting free blocks.

The new lower proof factors a general C5 block fit through subspaces and proves rank >= ceil(5L/2). PR2484’s source-bound I44 plus C5 witness then gives 44d+5d; its existing 49-support construction tensored with I_d attains the bound. The scalar result, witness and upper construction are credited to thakrarsagar/PR2484. Standard block fitting/fractional Haemers methods are credited, not claimed as new. A C5 control has scalar minimum 3 and two-block minimum 5<6, so scalar lower bounds do not automatically tensorize.

Exact checks authenticate selected labels, PR1825 matching, and unmodified 2484 sources by SHA256 and Git blob; reconstruct the strict ordered mask independently; check tensor attainers for d=1,2,3 over GF(2), GF(3), GF(101); execute all 224 columns of a noncommuting rank 98 vector query fit; and reject 6 effective faults. Git-free relocated read-only replay, source-pin corruption, typed receipt corruption and exclusive output checks pass. Both registered commands passed with CPython 3.12.14. A separate Codex peer independently replayed under 3.12.7 and reviewed the all-size proof/code with no blocking finding.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/paired-plane-block-rank/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/paired-plane-block-rank/check_integrity.py
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-block-rank
```

This is query-vector dimension for one fixed matching and complete zero mask, not native COPY cost, a legal frame/cleanup circuit, a supplier or a new kappa. The hand proof is not machine-formalized. It does not meet the original rank-shape card’s physical-cost/5% ceiling gate; that scope change is explicit. Concurrent 2525 formalizes the fixed two-port four-pivot Schur obstruction, whereas this proof covers arbitrary block size. PR2203’s independent-payload warning remains applicable.

Started from and rechecked canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4. Final REST overlap covers 734 open PRs at 13:51 UTC. The last complete Discussion cache has 1192 records at 12:04 UTC and is explicitly stale after GraphQL rate limits. Only research/paired-plane-block-rank is added. Open next questions and attribution are retained. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI peer review; no independent human review or hosted-CI pass claimed. Apache-2.0.
